judgment.rationale: The original report describes a one-key Caps Lock-to-Esc mapping that briefly stops working, but explicitly says it cannot reproduce the interruption. A later commenter links #37380 and says it is still happening; neither comment supplies a current version or trigger sequence.
evidence: The original report is on 0.67.1 and says Caps Lock briefly emits Caps Lock instead of Esc after editing in VS Code.
Disabling the mapping was needed to turn Caps Lock back off after the single leaked keypress.
A later comment says the issue is still happening and links #37380; no current build or sequence is given.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the reporter can confirm the current version and whether the interruption corresponds to a Keyboard Manager restart or a specific focus transition.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported transient interruption has no deterministic trigger, and the later related issue is not a confirmed fix or root-cause diagnosis.

issue_context.summary: Caps Lock briefly bypasses its Caps Lock-to-Esc remap after a rare background interruption, potentially leaving Caps Lock enabled; the report cannot reproduce the event.
known_information: The initial report used PowerToys 0.67.1 and remapped Caps Lock to Esc.
The symptom appeared once while switching/editing files in VS Code after an Alt+3 action.
A later commenter reports recurrence and links #37380, without a current build or reproduction details.
inferences: A brief module/hook interruption or focus-related event loss may allow a physical Caps Lock keypress through, but neither is demonstrated.
issue_context.analysis: The precise missing evidence is whether this happens on a current build and what state transition precedes the leaked keypress. Existing comments do not justify a generic log request or a code design.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live body and both comments, including the later #37380 reference.
Checked current labels, assignees, and linked work; no assigned owner or linked PR was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether the one-key Caps Lock-to-Esc bypass still occurs on a current PowerToys build and what observable event precedes it.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes an old-build issue from a current hook/module interruption and narrows the next reproduction.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Confirm current PowerToys version and, if it recurs, note whether Keyboard Manager's status or focus changed immediately before the single leaked Caps Lock keypress. Do not upload a generic archive unless a maintainer identifies a specific diagnostic need.

comment.body:
Thanks for the original Caps Lock-to-Esc report and the later confirmation linking #37380. The original report notes that the interruption was not reproducible, and the later comment does not say which current version is affected.

Please confirm whether this still occurs on a current PowerToys build. If it happens again, note whether Keyboard Manager's status or the active-window/focus state changed immediately before the one Caps Lock keypress bypassed the mapping. This distinction is more useful than a generic log upload.
